text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Parliament to pursue debate on draft law related to privatisation of telecommunications.
- Morocco trade deficit shrinks by 8.7 percent in 1996. Exports increased by nearly five percent in same period.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri says 1,000 houses will be built for people made homeless by recent floods in Casablanca.
- Union Constitutional Party still suffering internal crisis after death of leader Maati Bouabid.
